prompt: On the Account screen the Profile card is completely empty: no error message, no spinner, nothing. Figure out what's going on.

truth.summary: ProfileDetails throws reading address.city because the profile has no address; CardBody catches it and renders null.

referenceAnswer.cause: formatLocation reads address.city on a profile without an address, throwing a TypeError that CardBody catches and replaces with null.

decoyAnswers.cause: The profile query is still loading.
profile is undefined because the query returns null, so the error boundary renders nothing.
